flaws.description: Swapped sns.boxplot for sns.violinplot at its single call site, keeping all positional/keyword arguments (x, y, hue, data, palette, linewidth) unchanged since violinplot accepts them all, turning the box plot into a violin plot.

Changed one Resilience Score value for Tax Revenue Efficiency/Private (originally 75) to 34 (75 * 0.45 rounded), corrupting a single inline data point while table.csv still records the true value of 75.
